sentences.text: Bermuda -LRB- -LSB- pronbərˈmjuːdə -RSB- -RRB- is a British Overseas Territory in the North Atlantic Ocean .	Atlantic Ocean	Atlantic Ocean	British Overseas Territory	British Overseas Territories

It is approximately 1070 km east-southeast of Cape Hatteras , North Carolina ; 1236 km south of Cape Sable Island , Nova Scotia ; and 1578 km north of San Juan , Puerto Rico .	Cape Hatteras	Cape Hatteras	North Carolina	North Carolina	Cape Sable Island	Cape Sable Island	Nova Scotia	Nova Scotia
The capital city is Hamilton .	Hamilton	Hamilton, Bermuda	capital city	capital city
Bermuda is an associate member of Caribbean Community -LRB- CARICOM -RRB- .	Caribbean Community	Caribbean Community
The first person known to have reached Bermuda was the Spanish sea captain Juan de Bermúdez in 1503 , after whom the islands are named .	Spanish	Spain	Juan de Bermúdez	Juan de Bermúdez
He claimed the islands for the Spanish Empire .	Spanish	Spain	Spanish Empire	Spanish Empire
Bermúdez never landed on the islands , but made two visits to the archipelago , of which he created a recognisable map .	archipelago	archipelago

Shipwrecked Portuguese mariners are now thought to have been responsible for the 1543 inscription on Portuguese Rock -LRB- previously called Spanish Rock -RRB- .	Spanish	Spain	Portuguese Rock	Spittal Pond Nature Reserve

Subsequent Spanish or other European parties are believed to have released pigs there , which had become feral and abundant on the island by the time European settlement began .	Spanish	Spain	feral	feral

In 1609 , the English Virginia Company , which had established Jamestown in Virginia two years earlier , permanently settled Bermuda in the aftermath of a hurricane , when the crew and passengers of the Sea Venture steered the ship onto the surrounding reef to prevent its sinking , then landed ashore .	Virginia Company	Virginia Company	Jamestown	Jamestown, Virginia	Virginia	Colony of Virginia	Sea Venture	Sea Venture
The island was administered as an extension of Virginia by the Company until 1614 .	Virginia	Colony of Virginia
Its spin-off , the Somers Isles Company , took over in 1615 and managed the colony until 1684 .	spin-off	Corporate spin-off	Somers Isles Company	Somers Isles Company
At that time , the company 's charter was revoked , and the English Crown took over administration .	English Crown	English Crown

The islands became a British colony following the 1707 unification of the parliaments of Scotland and England , which created the Kingdom of Great Britain .	1707 unification	Acts of Union 1707	Kingdom of Great Britain	Kingdom of Great Britain
After 1949 , when Newfoundland became part of Canada , Bermuda became the oldest remaining British overseas territory .	Newfoundland	Newfoundland (island)
After the return of Hong Kong to China in 1997 , Bermuda became the most populous British territory .	Hong Kong	Hong Kong
Its first capital , St. George 's , was established in 1612 .
Bermuda 's economy is based on offshore insurance and reinsurance , and tourism , the two largest economic sectors .	insurance	insurance	reinsurance	reinsurance	tourism	tourism
Bermuda had one of the world 's highest GDP per capita for most of the 20th century and several years beyond .	GDP per capita	GDP per capita
Recently , its economic status has been affected by the global recession .
It has a subtropical climate .	subtropical	Subtropics

Bermuda is the northernmost point of the Bermuda Triangle , a region of sea in which , according to legend , a number of aircraft and surface vessels have disappeared under supposedly unexplained or mysterious circumstances .	Bermuda Triangle	Bermuda Triangle	legend	legend
The island is in the hurricane belt and prone to severe weather .	hurricane belt	hurricane belt
However , it is somewhat protected from the full force of a hurricane by the coral reef that surrounds the island .
